课程简介（中文）

有机化学实验室旨在为本科生提供全面的实验训练。除了帮助学生熟练掌握基础实验操作技能（包括有机化合物常用的合成方法及提纯与鉴定技术）外，该实验室课程还会围绕实验观察结果的数据分析以及反应机理的理解展开训练。本科生通过本课程所掌握的有机化学实验技能与问题解决能力，将为其未来的专业课程学习和科研工作奠定坚实基础。

课程简介（英文）

The organic chemistry laboratory aims to provide comprehensive training to the undergraduates. In addition to proficiency in basic laboratory techniques, which include commonly used synthetic methods and purification/identification skills of organic compounds, it offers training on data analysis capability based on experiment observations and mechanism understanding. The organic chemistry lab skills and problem solving skills that the undergraduates obtain from this course will set a robust foothold for their future major course study and research work.

教学目标

The goals of this course are

(1) To provide the undergraduates an opportunity to learn basic laboratory techniques which are used in organic chemistry experiments, and to develop problem solving ability.

(2) To help the undergraduates to establish academic honor and scientific integrity, and to develop proper laboratory etiquette.

(3) To facilitate a better understanding of fundamental knowledge in organic chemistry with first-hand laboratory experience.

教学方式

Lab experiment

教学内容与进度安排

Course Schedule (Please supply the details and objectives about each lesson):

Experiment 1. Lab Safety and Requirements of Organic Chemistry Lab, Check-in,

Requirements:

1  Get familiar with lab safety and requirements of organic chemistry lab.

2  Get familiar with commonly used glassware.

3  Learn the theory and technique of recrystallization, and practice recrystallization by using water as solvent.

  

Experiment 2. Recrystallization of Benzoic Acid in Water

Requirements:

1  Learn the theory and technique of recrystallization, and practice recrystallization by using water as solvent.

 

Experiment 3. Distillation of n-butanol

Requirements:

1  Learn the theory and master basic technique of simple distillation.

 

Experiment 4. Purification of 1-Bromobutane 

Requirements:

1  Maser the theory and technique of extraction and washing by using separatory funnel.

2  Master the technique of drying organic liquid (water removal) by using drying agent.

 

 

Experiment 5. Synthesis of Ethyl Benzoate

Requirements:

1 Master the technique of Dean-Stark trap.

2  Review and intensify basic skills of extraction, drying and distillation.

 

 Experiment 6. Synthesis of Diphenylmethanol

Requirements:

1  Learn and master the experimental techniques of semi microscale organic reactions.

2  Review and intensify the technique of recrystallization.

3  Prepare for next lab.

 

Experiment 7. Cannizzaro Reaction — Synthesis of Benzoic Acid and Benzyl Alcohol

Purpose:

Assess undergraduates’ performance on basic lab techniques learned in the semester.
